fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Hurls a plumb bob that deals 18 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Chalk-Line Mark
fusions.desc: Snaps a chalk line at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

fusions.name: Sight Down the String
fusions.desc: Your reach rises by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Quarry
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 15 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
